entry.title: Everton v Ipswich | CotC with Sean Norton & Paul Gaught-Allen | Planet FPL 2026/27

media:group.media:title: Everton v Ipswich | CotC with Sean Norton & Paul Gaught-Allen | Planet FPL 2026/27
media:group.media:description:
It's an all blue affair on the second Clash of the Correspondents today as James is joined by Everton fan Sean Norton and Ipswich fan Paul Gaught-Allen to do discuss encouraging starts for both clubs ths season ahead of the weekend meeting at Hill Dickinson Stadium.
But for Everton that start has come despite a disastrous close to the transfer window that has left the squad short of personnel - but the consequence is it makes a lot of their FPL assets more secure for minutes.
Saturday's starting back four are all covered and there are three genuinely interesting attacking options in Kierna Dewsbury-Hall, James Garner and Thierno Barry.
And Ipswich players should have interest too, Leif Davis has already outperformed his offensive season from two seasons ago, Zian Flemming is now ready to compete with Emersonn, Julio Enciso is impressing and they may even have this season's Midfield DEFCON monster.

entry.title: Fulham v Man Utd | CotC with Lewis James & Alex Trembath | Planet FPL 2026/27

media:group.media:title: Fulham v Man Utd | CotC with Lewis James & Alex Trembath | Planet FPL 2026/27
media:group.media:description:
On the first of two Clash of the Correspondents today James is joined by Fulham fan Lewis James and Manchester United fan Alex Trembath to discuss the latest at their clubs ahead of Sunday's meeting between the two at Craven Cottage.
It was a disappointing Derby defeat for United against City on Sunday and fears that something all to familiar is about to happen under Michael Carrick.
Fulham's Alvaro Arbeloa was already under pressure after losing the first three but some tactical tweaks and a change of some personnel led to a clean sheet at Liverpool.
So should Fantasy managers now longer be looking to target Fulham with United assets?
Discussion features Bruno Fernandes, Bryan Mbeumo, Harry Maguire and which Fulham assets should be under consideration ahead of three consecutive fixtures against the promoted teams straight after the International break.
